name: reprice_winter.sh
title: Bulk price update with a missing pair of brackets and a webhook per row
goal: Raise active winter and snow prices by 10%.
description: Without brackets the WHERE clause also hits inactive winter rows. A trigger on prices makes the shop send one partner webhook per changed row. Declared scope: table prices with a budget of 31 rows, no hosts. The webhooks stay out of scope until the operator declares hooks.partner.example.
